summary.text: Caleb Hinkle is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 68 who took office in January 2021 and is running for Montana State Senate District 34 on November 3, 2026.
A U.S. Army National Guard veteran, he previously worked as a field representative for then-Congressman Greg Gianforte.

paragraphs.text: Caleb Hinkle served in the U.S. Army National Guard, and his career experience includes working as a field representative for then-Congressman Greg Gianforte.
Hinkle assumed office in the Montana House on January 4, 2021.
In the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of the Fish, Wildlife and Parks Committee and a member of the House Judiciary and Transportation committees.
He is not seeking re-election to the House; he advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 34 and faces Democrat Carl Anderson in the general election.
